name: Stock Return Report
query: SELECT "Purchase Receipt" AS "Document Type", pr.posting_date AS "Return Date", CONCAT('', pr.name, '') AS "Document No", pr.supplier AS "Party", CAST(pr.grand_total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS "Total Amount", pr.status AS "Status", pr.posting_date AS order_date -- Keep raw date for ordering FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr WHERE pr.status IN ('Return', 'Return Issued') UNION ALL SELECT "Sales Invoice" AS "Document Type", si.posting_date AS "Return Date", CONCAT('', si.name, '') AS "Document No", si.customer AS "Party", CAST(si.grand_total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS "Total Amount", si.status AS "Status", si.posting_date AS order_date -- Keep raw date for ordering FROM `tabSales Invoice` si WHERE si.status IN ('Return', 'Return Issued') ORDER BY order_date DESC;
